name: markdown-table-column-floor
description: markdown: wide GFM tables (4+ columns) reflow to list-style key-value records below the 559px container threshold so narrow phone/split columns never collapse to 2-character strips, while wide panes and narrow (<=3 column) tables stay tabular with every column at a readable floor and enhanced entity chips contained inside their cell

mutation.declaration: markdown.module.css: remove @container (max-width: 559px) list-reflow rules or cell-level overflow-wrap: break-word - narrow 5/8-column tables stay crushed instead of stacking into record cards, or wide tables re-collapse short columns to ~2-character strips under inherited overflow-wrap: anywhere
mutation.note: Reproduces both the 2026-11-19 5-column collapse and the 2026-11-26 8-column phone/desktop collapse.
